groups.saying_opens: ما وجدته في كتاب الله ولا سمعته

notes: Two sayings with two isnads (rule 4a): Abu Said's saying, and the Ibn Abbas saying that Abu Said reports from his meeting with him.
In the second, Ibn Abbas is the speaker of the scene, and his source Usama bin Zayd (the Companion) is the last link; the Prophet is the end.
The Ibn Abbas link is read from the encounter ('لقيت ابن عباس'), since his reply is written with no name.
